acceptance.criterion_verbatim: the record has three fresh runs for each of the three sizes with every field, the guard is named, one row hash covers all runs, and chosen_partitions equals the size the rule gives when recomputed from the runs. It PASSES whatever size the rule chooses (30 is an answer).

mutant.description: The order names no mutant; the check recomputes the rule from the runs, so a record whose chosen_partitions disagrees with them is the discriminating arm.

declared_exclusions.reason: The order says a failed measurement is NOT re-run until it passes and no limit is relaxed: the three runs of 60 (growth) and of 120 (growth and a different row set) are the record.
